[issue by Fecavalry]
**Describe the bug**
Game crashes when adding fuel to a Blaze Burner with a straw while flywheel backend is off (flywheel:off).
The Blaze Burner has a working block  on top such like basin or fluid tank 

**To Reproduce**
when use fluid pipe adding fuel to blaze burner with a straw and blaze burner has a fluid tank on the top 
the game crash

- Mod version:1.5.10
- Forge version: neo forge 21.1.228
